summary: This is a GitHub profile README markdown file that displays a greeting, links to the user's repository list, and includes dynamically generated statistics about their GitHub activity and programming languages. It also sets up a placeholder for automatically listing recent blog posts.

explanations.1: This comment tells the markdown linter to ignore a specific rule (MD033) for HTML tags, since this file uses raw HTML for the table structure.
explanations.7: This line embeds a dynamic image badge from an external service that shows GitHub statistics like commit counts and icons, automatically updating to reflect the current data.
explanations.9: Similar to line 7, this embeds another dynamic badge showing which programming languages the user has used most across their repositories.
explanations.17: These HTML comments act as markers for an automated tool or GitHub Action that will insert the list of recent blog posts between them, replacing or updating this section periodically.
